# Avora

> Avora is an open-source macOS screen recorder written in Swift with ScreenCaptureKit. It zooms in on every click, draws a smooth cursor, records microphone, system audio and camera, writes captions on the Mac and exports MP4, HEVC, ProRes or GIF.

Download Avora.zip from https://github.com/halitsever/avora-screen-recorder/releases/latest and move Avora to Applications. It needs macOS 14 or later and Screen Recording permission. Builds are signed ad hoc, so open it the first time with right-click, Open.

## Docs

- [Using Avora](https://halitsever.github.io/avora-screen-recorder/#using): recording the screen, a window or an area, sound, camera, captions, keyboard badges and the editor
- [Automatic zoom](https://halitsever.github.io/avora-screen-recorder/#zoom): how clicks become zooms and how the camera follows your work
- [Backgrounds](https://halitsever.github.io/avora-screen-recorder/#backgrounds): no backdrop by default, gradients, colors, pictures and wallpaper
- [Install](https://halitsever.github.io/avora-screen-recorder/#install): download, updates, building from source and re-rendering a recording from the command line
- [Under the hood](https://halitsever.github.io/avora-screen-recorder/#hood): export settings, presets and the source layout
